title: Two-View Triangulation: DLT, Midpoint, Cheirality
hints: Write the projection as λ·[x;1] = P·[X;1] with P = [R|t] (3×4). The cross product with [x;1] eliminates λ.
Each view contributes two rows: x·P.row(2) − P.row(0) and y·P.row(2) − P.row(1). Stack them into a 4×4 A.
Solve A·X̃ = 0: X̃ = last column of V from JacobiSVD(A, ComputeFullV), then X = X̃.head<3>() / X̃(3).
Midpoint: centers C = −Rᵀt, directions d = Rᵀ[x;1]. Minimize |C1 + s·d1 − C2 − u·d2|² (a 2×2 linear system) and average the two closest points.
